_about: Curated legacy -> modern API map (11.x/12.x API moves; sources: Blizzard_Deprecated* shims of earlier patches, warcraft.wiki.gg 'API change summaries' and Ketho BIR). Every replacement is checked against the dump at run time; a replacement missing from the client is reported as such. kind: alias (same args/returns) | table (returns a struct instead of a tuple) | changed (other differences) | none (no replacement for addons).

COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED.note: registering it on Forever fires ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN and offers to disable the addon (pcall does not help). Use UNIT_COMBAT / UNIT_SPELLCAST_* / COMBAT_TEXT_UPDATE / C_DamageMeter.

UNIT_HEALTH_FREQUENT.note: merged into UNIT_HEALTH (9.0); health values are secret for many units

UNIT_POWER_FREQUENT.note: check the dump: UNIT_POWER_FREQUENT may still exist

WORLD_MAP_UPDATE.note: no world-map state events for addons; react to zone changes

CombatLogGetCurrentEventInfo.returns: Forever restricts COMBAT_LOG_EVENT(_UNFILTERED) and has no C_CombatLog.GetCurrentEventInfo. Use UNIT_COMBAT, UNIT_SPELLCAST_*, COMBAT_TEXT_UPDATE + C_CombatText.GetCurrentEventInfo and C_DamageMeter (amounts secret in combat); offline analysis: Logs/WoWCombatLog.txt

EasyMenu.returns: Blizzard_Menu API: MenuUtil.CreateContextMenu(owner, function(owner, rootDescription) rootDescription:CreateButton(text, fn) end)

GetContainerItemInfo.example: local info = C_Container.GetContainerItemInfo(bag, slot); if info then local count = info.stackCount end
GetContainerItemInfo.returns: ContainerItemInfo {iconFileID, stackCount, isLocked, quality, isReadable, hasLoot, hyperlink, isFiltered, hasNoValue, itemID, isBound}; old: texture, count, locked, quality, readable, lootable, link, isFiltered, noValue, itemID, isBound

GetCurrentMapAreaID.returns: C_Map.GetBestMapForUnit('player') returns uiMapID (different IDs from old map area IDs)

GetFriendInfo.returns: FriendInfo {name, level, className, area, connected, notes, guid}

GetItemInfo.returns: same tuple (itemName, itemLink, quality, itemLevel, minLevel, type, subType, stackCount, equipLoc, texture, sellPrice, classID, subclassID, bindType, expansionID, setID, isCraftingReagent); nil until GET_ITEM_INFO_RECEIVED / ITEM_DATA_LOAD_RESULT

GetMouseFocus.returns: GetMouseFoci() returns a table of regions under the cursor (top first)

GetPlayerMapPosition.returns: C_Map.GetPlayerMapPosition(uiMapID, 'player') returns a Vector2D (x, y = pos:GetXY()); nil in restricted areas

GetQuestLogTitle.returns: QuestInfo {title, questLogIndex, questID, level, isHeader, isCollapsed, frequency, isComplete, ...}

GetQuestsCompleted.returns: array of questIDs instead of a [questID]=true map

GetSpellBookItemInfo.returns: SpellBookItemInfo {actionID, spellID, itemType (Enum.SpellBookItemType), name, subName, iconID, isPassive, isOffSpec, skillLineIndex}; bookType string -> Enum.SpellBookSpellBank

GetSpellBookItemName.returns: bank argument is Enum.SpellBookSpellBank instead of 'spell'/'pet'

GetSpellCooldown.example: local cd = C_Spell.GetSpellCooldown(id); if cd and cd.duration > 0 then ... end
GetSpellCooldown.returns: SpellCooldownInfo {startTime, duration, isEnabled (boolean), modRate}; old: start, duration, enabled (1/0), modRate

GetSpellInfo.example: local info = C_Spell.GetSpellInfo(id); local name, icon = info and info.name, info and info.iconID
GetSpellInfo.returns: SpellInfo {name, iconID, originalIconID, castTime, minRange, maxRange, spellID}; old: name, rank, icon, castTime, minRange, maxRange, spellID, originalIcon. rank is gone. Returns nil for unknown spells.

GetSpellTabInfo.returns: SpellBookSkillLineInfo {name, iconID, itemIndexOffset, numSpellBookItems, isGuild, offSpecID, shouldHide, specID}

GetTalentInfo.returns: check the client's talent API (Forever uses the classic talent system)

InterfaceOptionsFrame_OpenToCategory.returns: takes the category ID (category:GetID()), not the panel

IsItemInRange.returns: protected against hostile units in combat on modern clients

IsSpellInRange.returns: boolean or nil instead of 1/0/nil; argument order (spell, unit) unchanged; spell may be ID or name (no book index form)

SendAddonMessage.returns: returns Enum.SendAddonMessageResult; outgoing addon messages can be restricted (C_ChatInfo.AreOutgoingAddonChatMessagesRestricted)

SendChatMessage.returns: the global may remain as a wrapper; chat output can be blocked during chat messaging lockdown

SetMapToCurrentZone.returns: no world-map state any more; use C_Map.GetBestMapForUnit('player')

UnitAura.example: local aura = C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByIndex(unit, i, filter); if not aura then break end
UnitAura.returns: AuraData {name, icon, applications, dispelName, duration, expirationTime, sourceUnit, isStealable, spellId, auraInstanceID, isHelpful, isHarmful, ...}; AuraUtil.UnpackAuraData(aura) rebuilds the old tuple. Prefer UNIT_AURA updateInfo + C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByAuraInstanceID.

UnitIsTappedByPlayer.returns: inverted meaning: UnitIsTapDenied(unit) is true when you can NOT get credit

UnitPopup_ShowMenu.returns: unit context menus are built with Menu.ModifyMenu('MENU_UNIT_...', fn)

UseContainerItem.returns: protected in combat for some items
